commits.subject: composite + renderer tests (SMB-COMPOSITE-DOCGRAPH-2 slice A): clip + unlinked mask on a moved layer, feathered unlinked parity, fractional/rotated moves proven
composite (SMB-COMPOSITE-DOCGRAPH-2 slice B): collapsed precompositions on the document graph

capabilities_done: goal 4: a vector clip and an unlinked vector mask on one layer (refused transform_unlinked_vector_mask_with_clip for every moved layer before) are split on the document graph as the scene path cuts them: the clip moves with the content inside an isolated wrapper group (coverage_u8 nib plane over the static rect, unfeathered), the mask stays on the layer in plan space with its feather and density (temporal.rs cut_unlinked, insert_wrapper); done on every frame so a layer does not change when it starts to move; the refusal remains only for a moved layer whose envelope entry carries more than the mask feather (effects, blur, filters, adjustment)

goal 3: feathered unlinked masks: the scene matte (composition.rs unlinked_mask_matte) cut the feather at the source rect and its taps clamped onto mask content; the document graph clamped at its own plane border; both planes now cover vector_mask::unlinked_rect (source bounds and region grown by pigment feather_support). Also found and fixed: an unlinked reveal_outside LUMINANCE mask made the layer vanish outside the mask art on the scene path (matte zero outside its plane); unlinked_mask_matte_in covers the composition (static_content passes the composition rect)

goal 2: fractional, rotated and scaled moves of clipped and masked layers on the document graph now have tests (composite from Folio records + render-cpu + render-gpu). Found and fixed on the way: a plane resampled with its content (transform_mask) is read by both backends in the tile's source coordinates from the plane's own origin, so composite refits an owned plane of a resampled layer to the tile rect (temporal.rs refit_plane); before, a clip or mask whose bounds started left/up of the tile was misaligned
wrap_masked_entry (matte wrapper) uses the shared insert_wrapper; matte plane keys come from next_key (plan keys and owned planes)

goal 5: composition_collapse_on_document_graph lifted: lower_document_frame splices a collapsed precomposition into the frame graph (splice_collapsed: the parent-composite edge of the precomposition layer replaced by one edge per nested layer, bottom first, later ordinals shifted; a raster nested layer without an operation gets a source operation); DocumentGraphSource hides the precomposition layer and gives each nested layer its nested matrix at the source tick followed by the layer's, visibility in both windows (outer window, nested duration, nested window, not a matte source) and opacity stream x the layer's opacity, as scene_of's collapse_into; nested track mattes are looked up in their own composition. Still refused composition_collapse_on_document_graph: a nested precomposition, a nested layer the graph already composites or two collapsed layers share, a nested non-raster layer without a graph operation (scene-path refusals for blend mode and matte apply to both)
